title: After minting NFT, sometimes latest minted NFT don't appears in account NFT using xrpl.js version-2.6.0
key_points: User encountered issue where sometimes the latest minted NFT does not appear in account's NFT using xrpl.js version-2.6.0.
The issue occurs after performing the minting operation and trying to find the latest minted NFT with URI passed in JSON object while minting.
User added setTimeout but it did not resolve the issue.
limitations: Limited information provided about the specific code or context of the problem.
asserts: The source claims that there is an issue where sometimes the latest minted NFT does not appear in account's NFT using xrpl.js version-2.6.0.
scope: The scope of this assertion is related to the functionality and behavior of the xrpl.js library when performing NFT minting operations.
